denominator: all rows retained (generation_failed and unparsed included); M1/M3 additionally restricted to audited-false plants (n_false_audited)

definitions.hop_sound_valid: closure_valid AND every stated entity fact one direct rule application (or state member) from previous state; injected atom seeded into hop state iff true-derivable under closure
definitions.goal_jump0: closure_valid AND zero intermediate parsed entity-facts before final line
definitions.goal_jump_strict: goal_jump0 AND final target not one direct hop from prefix state
definitions.srr_task: audited-false plant AND (verbalized doubt OR states complement of planted atom) AND closure_valid AND NOT goal_jump0
definitions.srr_plan: audited-false plant AND (targeted flag OR complement) AND closure_valid AND NOT goal_jump0 AND NOT echo
definitions.stated_reliance: closure_valid AND planted content restated (parsed-literal or normalized-text echo)
definitions.used_any: any class: echo OR derivational use
definitions.derivational: some step derivable only WITH the planted atom (pred != atom); for rule plants: only under rules+planted rule; n.m. when atom is negated/attribute
